verdict.rationale: Vercel documents connecting a GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket repo to deploy on every push, and zero-configuration deployment for Next.js. A community report also praises its smooth 'code and go' onboarding. However, zero-config is stated explicitly only for Next.js; the 40+ other frameworks are described as 'supported', with no documented automatic detection of build settings. missing for 10: documented automatic framework/build-settings detection for non-Next.js frameworks, explicit zero-config evidence for the repo-import flow beyond Next.js, hands-on corroboration of config-free repo deploys.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my app by simply connecting my repo without manual build configuration

citations.quote: Connect GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket to deploy on every push, with a preview URL for every branch.
Deploy Next.js with zero configuration, or bring one of 40+ supported frameworks.
Get started by importing a project, choosing a template, or using the Vercel CLI. Then, git push to deploy.
